user.title: Choose your fridge
user.description: Tuya Bluetooth devices in range are listed; Euhomy fridges advertise as "TY". Close the Euhomy app first: the fridge only talks to one device at a time.

credentials.title: Tuya credentials
credentials.description: The fridge ({address}) encrypts its Bluetooth traffic with a key that only the Tuya cloud knows. Enter the credentials of this fridge; see the README for how to look them up once.

data_description.device_id: Shown as "Device ID" or "Virtual ID" in the Tuya IoT platform
data_description.uuid: Shown as "UUID" in the Tuya IoT platform

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Tuya credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The fridge ({address}) rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.invalid_local_key: The local key must have at least 6 ASCII characters.
error.invalid_device_id: The device ID must be 1 to 22 ASCII characters.
error.invalid_uuid: The UUID must be 1 to 16 ASCII characters.
error.device_not_found: The fridge is no longer in Bluetooth range.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Close the Euhomy app and make sure the fridge is powered on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.no_response: The fridge did not answer. Most likely the local key is wrong.
error.invalid_auth: The fridge rejected the credentials. Check device ID and UUID.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_devices_found: No Tuya Bluetooth devices found. Power the fridge on, move it into range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and close the Euhomy app.
